Just when I thought things were getting back to normal a new delta variant is out a new strain of the virus and it's out becoming strong because idiots don't want to get vaccinated why can't some people just do their part so we can end this thing jeez I'm 24 now I was 22 when the pandemic started literally lost a year off from my 20s ugh. I just want everything to be normal again not having to wear mask again just walk into a store with my face and that's it. 

I want to go out and make some real friends for a change.

Please get vaccinated it isn't a hoax or a game it's your life.
